verdict.rationale: Retell ships a built-in Analytics dashboard that charts call and chat metrics such as success rate, latency, cost and concurrency, with filters and breakdowns. It also has built-in call success and sentiment scoring, and AI QA surfaces sentiment trends, so a founder gets dashboards without building them. Missing for 10: call duration metrics are not explicitly documented in the dashboard, outcome breakdowns beyond success rate are not shown, sentiment is not confirmed as a dashboard chart, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see call analytics — success rates, durations, outcomes, sentiment — in dashboards without building my own

citations.quote: Build custom Retell analytics dashboards to track call and chat metrics like success rate, latency, cost, and concurrency, with charts, filters, and breakdowns.
The Analytics dashboard charts your call and chat data so you can see how your agents are performing over time.
Built-in call success and sentiment scoring, plus custom fields synced to your CRM.
AI QA scores Retell calls on hallucination, knowledge base accuracy, latency, sentiment, and tool usage to surface quality trends and issues.
